text:
jonah: Heads-up: prepping a late wave 23:15-23:50 UTC. Plan: api -> runtime -> console -> router. Primary goal: promote quantized runtime in eu only for 20m canary. Call out any firm blockers now.

priya: api build 2.0.2 ready (sha-api-9b1). No schema/db changes. Canary tests green on eu-staging.

matt: runtime team: v3.2.0-quant needs router header whitelist update to accept X-Runtime-Feature:quant. Router versions < 11 will drop requests 400. Can we do staged router config reload after runtime canary?

iris: console change is purely UI text. We'll keep FEATURE_BETA off for canary. Release notes: https://docs.redwood/release/notes/patch-322 (short).

deploybot: deploybot: wave scheduled 23:20 UTC. Sequence: api(runtime-prewarm)=sha-api-9b1,sha-rt-3.2.0,sha-ui-22,sha-router-12. Canary policy: eu-only 1% traffic 20m, then 10% 10m. Auto-rollback enabled per ops rules.

jonah: Ops question: do we need to prewarm runtime KV cache before routing real traffic? If yes, add a prewarm step.

matt: yes, runtime will prewarm on first 50k tokens; deploybot can do a dry traffic soak using internal probe endpoints. Suggest prewarm step after api canary and before full runtime canary.

priya: Can we also pin a fallback runtime: sha-rt-3.1.9 in case router changes not applied?

matt: fallback ready. If router doesn't accept header, runtime should advertise backward-compatible mode (env RUNTIME_COMPAT=true). We'll prefer pin fallback only if deploybot signals router rejection.

release-bot: smoke summary from staging: 11/11 checks OK. p99 api 110ms, p99 runtime 210ms.

jonah: Rollback triggers (short):
- 0.8% error rate sustained 4min or
- p99 > 1.8s for 3min or
- Canary healthcheck failures > 2 per min for 5min.
If you see serious degradations, post exactly "rollback" in this thread. deploybot will run rollback-run.

iris: I'll be monitoring console errors and user-facing metrics.

priya: I'll watch api traces and will confirm canary start.

matt: I'll watch runtime metrics and router logs (will tail router-12). If header whitelist can't be applied within 10m after runtime canary, we hold and pin runtime to 3.1.9.

deploybot: deploybot: ready to kickoff on approval. Event stream to #release-notifications will start on wave start.

jonah: Approve to start at 23:20 UTC. Everyone keep mobile on.

priya: Approved.

iris: Approved.

matt: Approved.

release-bot: hook: alerts and SLO dashboards linked in thread.

jonah: Thanks team. I'll post short start note to #release-notifications and ping on-call at wave start.

matt: Note: router-12 config reload may take ~30s per instance; plan accordingly.

priya: adding canary label to incidents dashboard for quick filter.

jonah: Great. See you at 23:20.
